title: Laboratory Serum — 60s Continuous
creativeBrief: An adult fictional athletic subject undergoes a clearly triggered laboratory transformation into an extreme, balanced hyper-muscular form. The transformation remains continuous for the full 60-second take; camera, wardrobe, room response and sound all track the same event. Intimate anatomy remains non-explicit and covered.

character_policy.adult_status_source: Production brief specifies an adult fictional subject.
character_policy.real_person_reference_permissions: Use only fictional character designs or verified references with appropriate permission.

timelineSemantics: Seven semantic intervals overlay one continuous 60-second deformation event. No hard cuts in the growth passage.

continuityLocks.face: Preserve adult fictional identity across all frames.
continuityLocks.pectoralBalance: Left/right growth remains balanced in width, projection and thickness.
continuityLocks.anatomy: Continuous transitions across shoulder, chest, arm, back and torso.
continuityLocks.scale: Body mass, height and limb proportions develop coherently.
continuityLocks.wardrobe: Separate cloth simulation or deformation layer; maintain non-explicit coverage.
continuityLocks.terminal: Hold the new baseline through the final frame.

sound.mix: Preserve laboratory room tone; synchronize material and environmental cues to visible deformation.

reviewGates: final hold lasts full five seconds

source.status: no source attached to this project

storage.policy: Original source media remains immutable; derived frames, passes and exports are versioned separately.

notes: Timeline-driven Blender prototype is implemented in engine/video/blender_scene.py and engine/video/timeline_growth.py. Render with engine/video/render_project.py. The first preview and Blender scene must still be generated locally and visually reviewed; no render is claimed to exist yet.
